scope: Reviewed SSH access to one explicit named remote herdr session; real snapshot pane dashboard, explicit pane selection and bounded continuous read-only full/delta observe. Original one-shot remains supported.

host.policy: DNS name or IP only, no whitespace/control characters or URL

expectedHostKey.policy: ssh-ed25519 and canonical base64 SSH public-key wire blob; parse type/length, compare before authentication; reject extra lines/options

privateKeyPem.policy: explicit in-memory experimental OpenSSH Ed25519 key only; no discovery, persistence, diagnostics, artifact or clipboard capture

socketPath.policy: absolute canonical remote path <configRoot>/herdr/sessions/<session>/herdr.sock; no control characters, dot/dotdot or empty interior segments; derive fixed XDG_CONFIG_HOME from this path

herdrPath.policy: absolute remote executable path; shell-quote as data, no arbitrary command

session.policy: explicit named session only; reserved default is unsupported in this step

paneId.policy: Empty only for dashboard discovery in continuous mode; one-shot and actual observe require an explicit valid pane selected from the current authenticated snapshot. No default or first-pane fallback in GUI.

reviewConfirmed.policy: explicit review of source, target and expected host key; never inferred from import/scan

bounds.totalObserveBytesPolicy: 2 MiB applies to original one-shot only; continuous mode uses the bounded frame/consumer pipeline below, never an unbounded history.

commands.snapshot: one direct-streamlocal channel, one session.snapshot RPC, validate response id, ok/error and result.type=session_snapshot, read result.snapshot, then close
commands.observe: fixed /usr/bin/env with only shell-quoted XDG_CONFIG_HOME derived from canonical socketPath; shell-quoted herdrPath --session session terminal session observe resolvedTerminalId --cols 80 --rows 24; no SSH PTY/control/takeover/resize; close after validated full frame
commands.continuousObserve: same fixed target and quoting as one-shot. Use validated observer dimensions for --cols and --rows, default 80x24. Both mobile clients also offer 120x40 and 160x50. Acknowledge each full/delta after consumption. Stop on explicit cancel, EOF or protocol/size error. No SSH PTY, control, takeover or shared PTY resize.

lifecycle: Every attempt owns an internal generation; cancellation or target change invalidates it before transport cleanup.
Late frames and completions cannot replace newer UI state.
One-shot snapshot is labelled read-only and not realtime; refreshing is explicit.
No automatic retry, reconnect, credential fallback, trust acceptance or replay.
Authentication starts only after actual SSH host key comparison succeeds.
No remote write methods are exposed by this adapter, including from terminal callbacks.
Continuous mode publishes an authenticated dashboard before explicit pane selection; canonical socket/session binding is checked before publication.

First frame must be full; every later sequence must equal the previous sequence plus one, including full frames. Duplicate/gap/malformed data ends observation; stale display is labelled and never silently repaired.

No-data idle is valid after first full. Background, route leave, explicit stop and target edit invalidate the generation and close the owned transport; resume requires a new reviewed connection and new full.
Native IPC has one frame in flight and waits for GUI render acknowledgement; stale selection/ack commands cannot affect a newer generation.

cli.negativeEvidence: wrong-pin must reach the actual key callback, fail comparison and never start authentication; transport timeout/refusal does not pass this case
cli.secrets: config and keys live only in the self-created CI temporary fixture; outputs contain no config, credentials, raw server messages or raw stdout/stderr
cli.observeEvidence: positive: >=3 frames and >=1 delta, then active cancellation; cancel: exactly first full then active cancellation; reconnect: two explicitly initiated observe calls in one CLI process, each full+delta. All require actual pin/auth/snapshot and errorCode=cancelled. Decoded single-frame high-water <=65536 is not whole-process memory or SSH buffer evidence.

binding.snapshot: exact selected paneId must exist uniquely in result.snapshot.panes and resolve to terminal_id matching ^term_[0-9a-f]+$
binding.observe: use that resolved terminal_id as CLI target, never reuse paneId as fallback; force the same derived config root and named session
binding.boundary: herdr 0.9.5 snapshot/frame do not echo session identity; binding relies on pinned server path and terminal resolver semantics, not a frame identity field
binding.dashboard: Parse only the current named session snapshot, at most 256 unique pane_id/terminal_id pairs; reject duplicate identifiers. Empty panes is a real empty dashboard, not network failure. No cross-session discovery is claimed.

continuousBounds.canvas: Each frame carries integer width (2..512) and height (1..512), with at most 65536 cells. The first frame is full. A geometry change requires a full frame at the next sequence. The wire dimensions describe the observer rendering area. The shared PTY size is independent.
continuousBounds.history: Keep only the current observer screen without scrollback. bufferHighWaterBytes measures one decoded frame. Local pan, keyboard and viewport changes do not resize the shared PTY.
